title: A Temporal Algebraic Framework for Data Stream Evaluation Under Delayed Labels and Distribution Shifts
abstract: arXiv:2611.21914v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In data streams, labels often arrive late or only for some instances, class prevalence drifts, and rare classes vanish from short windows. Standard evaluation then confuses a degraded decision boundary with a change in prevalence, and is biased when labels are delayed or selected by the model. We extend an algebraic framework that obtains pooled (micro) and per-class (macro) measures from one confusion matrix to streams, weighting the counts in time by exponential fading or a sliding window; the update costs O(m^2) per step, whatever the stream length, and each pooled measure stays a weighted combination of the per-class ones. Delayed and selective feedback enter as an observation mask: until its label arrives, an instance is counted with the model's calibrated class probabilities, and the bias of this interim estimate is driven by their calibration error. translated_title: 面向延迟标签与分布漂移下数据流评估的时序代数框架
translated_abstract: 在数据流中，标签常常延迟到达或仅对部分实例可用，类别流行度会发生漂移，稀有类别会在短时间窗口中消失。此时，标准评估方法会将决策边界的退化与流行度的变化相混淆，并且在标签延迟或由模型选择性提供时产生偏差。我们将一个能够从单一混淆矩阵获得汇总（微平均）与逐类别（宏平均）度量的代数框架扩展至数据流场景，通过指数衰减或滑动窗口对计数进行时间加权；无论数据流长度如何，每步更新代价仅为 O(m^2)，且每个汇总度量始终保持为逐类别度量的加权组合。延迟和选择性反馈以观测掩码的形式纳入框架：在标签到达之前，实例以模型校准后的类别概率进行计数，该临时估计的偏差由其校准误差决定。经审计的约定对没有已验证实例的类别不报告任何数值。我们……
tldr: 该论文提出将基于混淆矩阵的代数框架扩展到数据流评估，通过指数衰减或滑动窗口进行时间加权，并以观测掩码和校准概率处理延迟与选择性标签反馈，从而在分布漂移下以每步 O(m²) 的代价区分决策边界退化与类别流行度变化。
en_tdlr: This paper extends an algebraic confusion-matrix framework to data stream evaluation, using exponential fading or sliding-window temporal weighting and an observation mask with calibrated probabilities to handle delayed and selective label feedback, thereby disentangling decision-boundary degradation from prevalence drift at O(m²) per-step cost.
